Functions¶

In [7]:
# Manhattan plot
custom_manhattan  <- function(data, id, cutoff){
  # code from https://danielroelfs.com/blog/how-i-create-manhattan-plots-using-ggplot/
  
  # compute cumulative
  data_cum <- data %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(CHR) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(max_bp = max(START)) %>% 
    mutate(bp_add = lag(cumsum(max_bp), default = 0)) %>% 
    select(CHR, bp_add)
  
  # join it with df
  data <- data %>% 
  inner_join(data_cum, by = "CHR") %>% 
  mutate(bp_cum = START + bp_add)
  
  print(id)
  print(data[data$count>cutoff, ]$SYMBOL)
  
  # parameters
  axis_set <- data %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(CHR) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(center = mean(bp_cum))

  ylim <- max(data$count+cutoff)
  
  # make plot
  manhplot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = bp_cum, y = count, 
                                  color = as_factor(CHR), size = count)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cutoff, color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_x_continuous(label = axis_set$CHR, breaks = axis_set$center) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0, ylim)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("#276FBF", "#183059"), unique(length(axis_set$CHR)))) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5,3)) +
  labs(x = NULL, 
       y = "count") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme( 
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_markdown(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, size = 8, vjust = 0.5))+
    ggtitle(glue::glue("Manhattan plot of \n pseudo-counts in {id}")) + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  geom_text(aes(label=ifelse(count>cutoff,as.character(SYMBOL),'')),hjust=-0.2,vjust=0)
  return(list(plot = manhplot, top_genes=data[data$count>cutoff, ]$SYMBOL))
}

Manhattan plot with pseudo-bulks to visualize genes with abnormal high counts

In [14]:
options(repr.plot.width = 7, repr.plot.height = 3)
m <- as.matrix(seurat_obj@assays$RNA@counts)
annot <- web_mrt %>%
    dplyr::filter(SYMBOL %in% rownames(m))
  
m_sub <- m[annot$SYMBOL,]
c_sub <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(rowSums(m_sub)))
colnames(c_sub)<- c("count")
  
df <- cbind(annot,c_sub)
df <- df %>% mutate(CHR=case_when(CHR=="X"~"23",
                                 CHR=="Y"~"24",
                                 TRUE ~ as.character(CHR)))
df$CHR <- as.numeric(df$CHR)
df <- df[order(df[,"CHR"], df[,"START"]), ]
  
p <- custom_manhattan(df, patient, 150000)
p$plot

[1] "MALAT1"
